sn55.27:1.2: tena kho pana samayena anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn55.27:1.3: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi
sn55.27:1.4: ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkama upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena āyasmato ānandassa pāde sirasā vanda
sn55.27:1.5: anāthapiṇḍiko bhante gahapati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
sn55.27:1.6: so āyasmato ānandassa pāde sirasā vandatīti.
sn55.27:1.8: sādhu kira bhante āyasmā ānando yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn55.27:2.1: evaṃ bhanteti kho so puriso anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa paṭissutvā yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
sn55.27:2.2: anāthapiṇḍiko bhante gahapati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn55.27:2.3: so āyasmato ānandassa pāde sirasā vandati
sn55.27:2.5: sādhu kira bhante āyasmā ānando yena anāthapiṇḍikassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
sn55.27:3.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena anāthapiṇḍikassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. nisajja kho āyasmā ānando anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca
sn55.27:3.2: kacci te gahapati khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti.
sn55.27:3.3: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
sn55.27:4.1: catūhi kho gahapati dhammehi samannāgatassa assutavato puthujjanassa hoti utrāso hoti chambhitattaṃ hoti samparāyikaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ.
sn55.27:4.3: idha gahapati assutavā puthujjano buddhe appasādena samannāgato hoti.
sn55.27:4.4: tañca panassa buddhe appasādaṃ attani samanupassato hoti utrāso hoti chambhitattaṃ hoti samparāyikaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ.
sn55.27:5.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati assutavā puthujjano dhamme appasādena samannāgato hoti.
sn55.27:5.2: tañca panassa dhamme appasādaṃ attani samanupassato hoti utrāso hoti chambhitattaṃ hoti samparāyikaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ.
sn55.27:6.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati assutavā puthujjano saṅghe appasādena samannāgato hoti.
sn55.27:6.2: tañca panassa saṅghe appasādaṃ attani samanupassato hoti utrāso hoti chambhitattaṃ hoti samparāyikaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ.
sn55.27:7.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati assutavā puthujjano dussīlyena samannāgato hoti.
sn55.27:7.2: tañca panassa dussīlyaṃ attani samanupassato hoti utrāso hoti chambhitattaṃ hoti samparāyikaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ.
sn55.27:7.3: imehi kho gahapati catūhi dhammehi samannāgatassa assutavato puthujjanassa hoti utrāso hoti chambhitattaṃ hoti samparāyikaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ.
sn55.27:8.1: catūhi kho gahapati dhammehi samannāgatassa sutavato ariyasāvakassa na hoti utrāso na hoti chambhitattaṃ na hoti samparāyikaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ.
sn55.27:8.3: idha gahapati sutavā ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
sn55.27:8.4: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.27:8.5: tañca panassa buddhe aveccappasādaṃ attani samanupassato na hoti utrāso na hoti chambhitattaṃ na hoti samparāyikaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ.
sn55.27:9.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati sutavā ariyasāvako dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
sn55.27:9.2: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo …pe… paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
sn55.27:9.3: tañca panassa dhamme aveccappasādaṃ attani samanupassato na hoti utrāso na hoti chambhitattaṃ na hoti samparāyikaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ.
sn55.27:10.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati sutavā ariyasāvako saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
sn55.27:10.2: supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
sn55.27:10.3: tañca panassa saṅghe aveccappasādaṃ attani samanupassato na hoti utrāso na hoti chambhitattaṃ na hoti samparāyikaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ.
sn55.27:11.1: puna caparaṃ gahapati sutavā ariyasāvako ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akkhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.27:11.2: tāni ca panassa ariyakantāni sīlāni attani samanupassato na hoti utrāso na hoti chambhitattaṃ na hoti samparāyikaṃ maraṇabhayaṃ.
sn55.27:11.3: imehi kho gahapati catūhi dhammehi samannāgatassa sutavato ariyasāvakassa na hoti utrāso na hoti chambhitattaṃ na hoti samparāyikaṃ maraṇabhayanti.
sn55.27:12.4: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.27:12.8: yāni cimāni bhante bhagavatā gihisāmīcikāni sikkhāpadāni desitāni nāhaṃ tesaṃ kiñci attani khaṇḍaṃ samanupassāmīti.
